notes: Fixes the Debian Shell exiting with code 159 right after rootfs extraction. The bundled PRoot is now Termux's Android-linked 5.1.107.102 build with its talloc/shmem libraries and loader inside the APK, so Android's seccomp filter no longer kills it; Termux does not need to be installed. Debian Shell 1.1.3 requires this host. Same signing certificate for in-place update.
